items.text: Cosponsored a bill to end income tax on public pension benefits and replace, from general revenue, what those taxes send to the program's funds.
Cosponsored a bill to bar food assistance from paying for soft drinks, candy, ice cream, and prepared desserts, and to limit eligible foods to a list set by nutrient content.
